entries.proposition: Eight patient-derived DIPG cultures have a median 72-hour THZ1 IC50 of 56 nM (range 28 to 533 nM).
entries.snippet: with a median 72-hour IC50 of 56 nM in eight patient–derived DIPG cell cultures tested (range: 28 to 533 nM)

entries.proposition: THZ1 brain parenchymal concentration was measured by LC-MS/MS: about 13.7 ng/g or about 24 nM after intraperitoneal dosing and about 600 nM after intravenous dosing; this is a measured exposure, unlike the inference of an absent survival effect.
entries.snippet: we quantified brain penetration and observed an average THZ1 brain parenchymal concentration of 13.7 ng/g or approximately 24 nM following i.p. dosing, and approximately 600 nM following i.v. dosing
entries.anchor: Results / CDK7 inhibition with THZ1 impairs DIPG growth

entries.proposition: Intravenous dosing could be kept for only one week because of tail-vein sclerosis; intraperitoneal dosing in an aggressive xenograft gave only about 20 percent longer median survival.
entries.snippet: THZ1 administration resulted in a significant but modest (∼20%) increase in median survival when compared to vehicle-treated control mice
entries.anchor: Results / CDK7 inhibition with THZ1 impairs DIPG growth

entries.proposition: Dose and schedule used by the paper: THZ1 10 mg/kg, intravenous or intraperitoneal as indicated, five days a week; the number of animals, the sampling time and the tissue matrix of the concentration measurement are not stated in the text read.
entries.snippet: Administration of THZ1 was performed systemically with intravenous tail vein or intraperitoneal injection (as indicated) five days per week (M-F) at 10 mg/kg.

entries.proposition: The authors conclude that better brain delivery of CDK7 inhibitors is needed for translation, and a bromodomain inhibitor tested by the same method reached only about 150 nM in brain.
entries.snippet: with better brain tissue delivery required for optimal clinical translation
entries.anchor: Results / CDK7 inhibition with THZ1 impairs DIPG growth

entries.proposition: No normal brain tissue, neuronal or behavioural safety endpoint is reported for THZ1 in this paper; the readouts are tumour cell viability, RNA polymerase II phosphorylation in tumour cultures, tumour burden and survival.
entries.snippet: Consistently, we observed loss of RNAPII CTD phosphorylation 24 hours after THZ1 treatment
